name: Kawaura Yoshiharu
source:
4 years after the events of Episode 2, with the help of all dear people around him, Hal returned to the investment world [spoiler]and became the Hero of the Lunar Surface after exposing Avalon's deception. 
This time, he faces a bigger problem that can bring the end to the Lunar Surface. 
Hal has 2 goals left need to be fulfilled: To the untrod land and find Hagana to start everything over again with her.[/spoiler]
